latin: Per supercoelestem locum habemus intelligere quod de secunda trinitate plus est intelligibile quam intellectuale; per subcoelestem concauitatem quod magis intellectuale quam intelligibile. Per coelum id quod aeque utroque participat.

translation: 'Supercelestial place' is for us to take as what, within the second triad, is intelligible more than intellectual; 'subcelestial hollow' as what is intellectual more than intelligible; 'heaven' as what takes part in the two alike.
